evidence.quote: I used a combination of 3/4", 1/2", and 1/4" pieces to build out the appropriate amount for the push to open drawer slides to mount to.
This is undoubtedly the most cumbersome step of the entire project! But don't worry, it's not all that bad.
To do this, I notched around the C-channel cross member on the router table.
I used the 2-1/2" expanding hose from rockler along with a port and Y fitting. These were secured in place with tin strapping.
